listingTitle: Append formatted Rust text without a temporary String
title: Append formatted Rust text without a temporary String
why: Appending the result of format! allocates a temporary String before copying it into the destination String.
suggestion: Import std::fmt::Write and write directly into the destination String with write!.
limitations: Only explicitly typed String parameters and function-local variables initialized with String constructors are reported.
Aliases, custom string types, and whether the allocation is material in the current path are not inferred.
